title: Vitrina sales agent — tool-calling and structured-output contract
description: Frozen contract between the conversation engine (owner: M1) and the catalog/consent modules. Tools are exposed to Muse Spark in OpenAI-compatible `tools` format; the `definitions.tools[*].parameters` objects are passed verbatim. Every tool is scoped to the current seller_id and conversation_id server-side; the model never supplies them. Changes require a spec amendment (constitution Art. VI).

AgentTurnOutput.description: The only shape the agent may return as its final answer (spec FR-025). Produced via response_format=json_schema when the provider supports it; otherwise prompt-constrained JSON with a repair pass.

reply.description: Customer-facing text in Spanish (es-CO), in the seller's voice. No markdown. May contain at most one price per cited fact.

cited_fact_ids.description: IDs of facts or products from the retrieved context that support every factual claim in `reply`. Empty only for greetings, clarifying questions or handoffs.

confidence.description: Self-assessed confidence that `reply` is fully supported by `cited_fact_ids`. Below seller.low_confidence_threshold (default 0.6) the engine substitutes the fallback and counts a low-confidence turn.

handoff_reason.description: Non-null means the engine MUST call handoff_to_human after sending `reply` (if the model did not already call it).

objection_tag.description: Objection detected in the customer's last message, if any. The engine records it via record_objection when non-null.

proposed_consent_prompt.description: True when `reply` ends with the seller's consent prompt (e.g. '¿Te aviso cuando llegue tu talla o haya promo? Responde SÍ'). The engine then marks the conversation as awaiting consent so the next affirmative reply is recorded via record_consent.

function.name: search_catalog
function.description: Buscar productos y datos del negocio relevantes para la pregunta del cliente. Úsalo antes de afirmar cualquier precio, disponibilidad, envío o política. Devuelve fragmentos con fact_id que debes citar.

image_ref.description: Referencia a la imagen normalizada del cliente para búsqueda visual

function.name: get_product
function.description: Obtener el detalle completo de un producto (precio, stock, atributos, anuncios aprobados).

function.name: check_stock
function.description: Verificar unidades disponibles (stock menos reservas activas) de un producto, opcionalmente por variante.

tracked.description: false = el vendedor no lleva inventario; no prometas disponibilidad

function.name: reserve_item
function.description: Reservar unidades de un producto para este cliente por 24 horas. Solo cuando el cliente lo pide explícitamente y check_stock confirmó disponibilidad.

code.description: Código corto para el cliente, p. ej. R-4F2K

function.side_effects: decrements available stock atomically; emits ad.reservation attribution event; blocked in dry_run

function.name: book_slot
function.description: Agendar una cita (modo servicios: barbería, gimnasio, taller). Solo dentro del horario del negocio.

starts_at.description: Hora local del negocio en ISO-8601 con offset

function.side_effects: creates booking; emits ad.booking attribution event; blocked in dry_run

function.name: send_ad_asset
function.description: Enviar al cliente la imagen de un anuncio aprobado del producto (por ejemplo, la variante en el color que pidió).

ad_id.description: Anuncio específico; si es null, el motor elige el aprobado más reciente que coincida con la variante

function.side_effects: queues an outbound image message (respects 6 s spacing); only approved, verifier-passed creatives can be sent

function.name: handoff_to_human
function.description: Pasar la conversación al dueño del negocio. Úsalo cuando el cliente lo pide, hay queja, reembolso, problema de pago, tema médico, pedido grande, descuento fuera de política o no tienes el dato. Después de llamarlo, despídete brevemente y no respondas más.

summary.description: Resumen en español para el dueño: quién, qué quiere, qué falta. Sin datos personales más allá del nombre.

function.side_effects: sets conversation.mode = human; notifies seller via WhatsApp; emits ad.handoff; agent stops replying until release

function.name: record_objection
function.description: Registrar la objeción que frena al cliente (precio, envío, talla, disponibilidad, confianza, tiempo, pago). Alimenta los próximos anuncios.

quote.description: Cita corta del cliente; el motor la redacta antes de guardarla

function.side_effects: appends objection; emits ad.objection attribution event

function.name: record_consent
function.description: Guardar la autorización del cliente para recibir avisos y promociones, SOLO después de que respondió afirmativamente a la pregunta de consentimiento. Nunca lo llames por silencio ni por una respuesta ambigua.

response_text.description: Texto literal con el que el cliente aceptó

function.side_effects: appends to consent ledger with text_shown (from the pending prompt), response_text, channel=whatsapp, evidence_message_id; the engine independently verifies the response is affirmative and that a prompt was shown

function.name: opt_out
function.description: Dar de baja al cliente de cualquier mensaje promocional de inmediato. Úsalo si el cliente escribe BAJA, 'no más mensajes', 'stop' o pide no ser contactado.

also_erase_data.description: true si el cliente pide BORRAR MIS DATOS

function.side_effects: sets contact.opted_out_at; cancels pending sends; optionally schedules erasure within 24 h. Note: the engine also detects opt-out keywords before the model runs (FR-063); this tool covers paraphrased requests.

EngineRules.description: Deterministic rules the conversation engine enforces around the model, regardless of what the model returns.
rules: R1 Scope: only `active` facts and products are retrievable; `draft` items are never passed to the model (FR-003).
R2 Price validator: every monetary expression in `reply` must match an amount in `cited_fact_ids`. Violation → one guided retry → fallback reply + handoff(price_unverified) (FR-026).
R3 Groundedness: a reply with factual claims and empty `cited_fact_ids` is treated as confidence 0.
R4 Low confidence: confidence < 0.6 → fallback reply 'No tengo ese dato, te comunico con {owner_name}'; two consecutive → handoff(low_confidence_twice).
R5 Handoff consistency: if `handoff_reason` is non-null and the model did not call handoff_to_human, the engine calls it with that reason.
R6 Human mode: when conversation.mode == human, the model is not invoked at all.
R7 Opt-out first: keyword opt-out/erasure is applied before retrieval or model calls.

R8 Consent gating: record_consent succeeds only if the previous outbound message had proposed_consent_prompt == true and the inbound text is affirmative per the affirmative-lexicon (sí, si, claro, dale, listo, ok, de una, por favor avísame).
R9 Side effects in dry_run: reserve_item, book_slot, send_ad_asset, handoff_to_human, record_consent and opt_out return simulated results with status 'skipped_dry_run'.
R10 Off-topic: scope classifier runs on every inbound; off-topic → canned polite decline, objection_tag=off_topic, no retrieval.
R11 Medical/legal/financial advice requests → handoff(medical_topic or other) without answering.
R12 Outbound pacing: ≥ 6 s between messages to one recipient; 429/5xx → exponential backoff, max 3 attempts.
